product: SMAP Enhanced L3 Radiometer Global and Polar Grid Daily 9 km EASE-Grid Soil Moisture V006 (SPL3SMP_E)
attribution: SMAP Enhanced L3 Radiometer Global and Polar Grid Daily 9 km EASE-Grid Soil Moisture V006. Version 006. NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center Distributed Active Archive Center. https://doi.org/10.5067/M20OXIZHY3RJ.
method: Each res-6 cell whose centre lies in the region box takes the value of the grid pixel containing its centre (nearest-pixel sampling, as for the NASA POWER layers); neighbouring cells repeat values. SMAP SPL3SMP_E surface soil moisture: mean of the AM and PM DCA retrievals with recommended quality (retrieval_qual_flag bit 0 = 0), 20250701-20250707; the 9 km EASE-Grid 2.0 pixel is found by projecting the cell centre to EPSG:6933.
sampling: nearest grid pixel at each cell centre
